subject: physics
content: A small particle moves to position from its initial position under the action of force . The value of work done will be __________ J.
explanation:
The given expression calculates the work done by a force vector when it acts on an object that moves from an initial position vector to a final position vector .

To find the work done, we use the dot product of the force and displacement vectors :
